resources.string: Apps from %1$s can only be tracked, because it offers no file to install.
Apps without a wait of their own wait this long before a new release is offered, so a bad one can be pulled first.
Filter links by what they say
The filter is matched against the text of a link instead of its address.
Otherwise the last link in order is taken.
Otherwise links are put in natural order of their address, with numbers read as numbers.
Go by the end of the address
Links are put in order, and versions read, by the part after the last slash.
On each page, the links that match are put in order and the last one is followed.
A host name alone, such as gh-proxy.com. Tern reaches it over HTTPS.
That is not a host name Tern can use
